[[Tanned Hide Square]] is a common crafting material. It is used for crafting armor for most [[profession]]s.

==Acquisition==
* Purchased from [[material trader]]s.
* [[Salvage Kit|Salvaged]] from:
** Armor crafted with Tanned Hide Squares (see below).
** See [[:Category:Contains hide]] for other items.
* For known [[creature]]s that [[drop]] Tanned Hide Squares see [[:Category:Drops hide]].
